description: This file defines the internal implementation of a font family class for the PDFsharp library, handling platform-specific font family objects for GDI and WPF, and managing font family caching and creation.

classes.name: FontFamilyInternal
classes.description: Internal class representing a font family, encapsulating platform-specific font family objects and managing font family caching.

methods.name: GetOrCreateFromName
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a font family instance based on its name, managing platform-specific object creation and caching.

methods.name: GetOrCreateFromGdi
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a font family instance from a GDI font family object, utilizing caching.

methods.name: GetOrCreateFromWpf
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a font family instance from a WPF font family object, utilizing caching.
